Advantages of New Arc Design
No need for a dedicated switchyard with spreader/recombiner incorporated into the arc design
Optimization of magnet bending angles in addition to quadrupole components allows for greater compactness and minimal orbit excursion (equal same-direction bends used as initial condition in the optimization)
Greater dynamic aperture and momentum acceptance expected with linear-field lattice
Simpler linear combined-function magnet design
Fully scalable Optics
